rationale: All runs are feasible with wide headroom (0 DRC, hold >= +0.079 ns, <=18 slew/cap pins vs bar 89), so only T_eff matters. At the 4.5 ns floor AREA 3 beat DELAY 3 (4.17 vs 4.46 ns); DELAY 3 hit a wall (slack +0.04), AREA 3 did not (+0.33). With cap213, final slack tracks the placement setup margin plus ~0.13 ns (md5, ocs_blitter, round 1), so with period_frac at its floor the repair margins are the remaining lever. Setting 1: round-1 best with both setup margins at the 0.4 maximum. Setting 2: same plus ocs_blitter's DRC-clean denser floorplan (util 40, density 55%) to shorten wires, isolating geometry against setting 1.
